methods.description: Read the marked turn on a compass rose, measure clockwise from north for a three-digit true bearing or from north/south towards east/west for a compass bearing, and check the requested notation.
Locate the direction and use the 90-degree, 180-degree or 360-degree angle relationship to convert between compass and true bearings.
For the same line in the opposite direction, add 180 degrees below 180 or subtract 180 degrees at 180 or above; convert the resulting bearing if requested.
